title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Principle 08 ]

blocks.text: When I was young, I liked to collect things, but now I like mountain biking.
I joined a mountain biking club where we not only ride bikes, but we also go camping and protect the environment, which are activities I enjoy very much.
I don’t have as much free time these days, so I don’t get to do these things as much as I would like.
I would love to spend more time doing my favorite pastimes when I get a chance.
My coworkers, whom I am close to, get together at least once a month.
Sometimes we meet without our families, and other times, we all bring our families together.
It is very important to be a part of these activities for me.
During these get together we commemorate weddings, funerals or any other special event that had occurred or will occur during that month.
Last summer vacation, we went to Je-ju Island, and it was great!
When I meet with my high school friends once a month,5 we talk about the good times that we had when we were young or go to the singing room.
We surprise each other sometimes when we realize we are all getting older.
During these meetings, we also discuss the plan of saving money for our trip abroad together ten years later.
